title: Icabona c'umuriro
intro: Umuntu yimbitse, yiyemeje guhishura ukuri kw’iherezo, yaratanguye urugendo rwo kuvumbura ivy’impwemu. Ukwemera kwabo kudahungabana kwatumye barwanya ingingo mfatirwako zashinzwe, bagahura n’ibigeragezo bikomeye cane vyagerageza aho ukwizera gushika. Inkuru y’uwo mutima ni igihe c’uburinzi n’uburongozi bw’Imana.
clues: Narahezagiwe n’izina ry’icubahiro ridasanzwe rivuye ku Mukama wanje, ryerekana ubucuti bukomeye kandi budasanzwe.
Ubuzima bwanje bwa mbere nabumaze mu bantu bapfukamira ibishushanyo vy’ubuhinga, ariko umutima wanje wari wipfuza cane Imana imwe y’ukuri.
Narabona ibintu vyo mw’ijuru, izuba, ukwezi n’inyenyeri, niyumvira ukuntu biduga n’ukuntu bigwa, nca mfata ingingo y’uko bidashobora kuba Umukama wanje.
Mu gikorwa co gutera umugongo ugusenga Imana nyinshi kwari gukwiragiye, narahanganye n’imana z’ikinyoma, nsiga imana imwe yonyene, nini kuruta, idakomeretse nk’umuntu arega ata co avuga.
Ingorane nari mfise yo gusenga ibigirwamana yatumye ngira igihano gikomeye, kuko naciriwe urubanza rwo guterwa mu muriro w’iteka.
Yamara, kubera itegeko ry’Umuremyi wanje, iyo miriro ikaze yarahindutse isoko y’ubukonje n’umutekano, irazigama ubuzima bwanje.
arabic: قَالُوا۟ ٱبْنُوا۟ لَهُۥ بُنْيَـٰنًۭا فَأَلْقُوهُ فِى ٱلْجَحِيمِ
verse: They said, "Construct for him a structure [i.e., furnace] and throw him into the burning fire." (37:97)
